system.description:
Play the Agent if you want to manage webs of contacts

Features

Well-Connected. So long as you are in a civilized place, you always know someone that can help you. Spend a Hope to mark them as a Contact: name them, note how they'll be useful, and choose one:

  • They owe you a favour, but they’ll be hard to find
  • They’ll ask for something in return
  • They’re in trouble, as always
  • You were lovers once. It’s complicated
  • You didn’t part on good terms

You can have a number of Contacts equal to your level.

Fixer. Once per session, you may call in an established contact. Describe how they aid you, choosing from below:

  • They deliver gold, a rare tool, or a needed object
  • They assist, adding +4 to a Duality Die on your next roll
  • They ambush, adding 2d8 to your next damage roll
